title: Hardship Settlement Opening Payment and the Signing Window
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Opening-Payment Shortening of the Signing Window

**Rule.** When a consumer accepts a Hardship Settlement offer of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements by electronic signature, the Hardship Settlement opening payment is the whole settlement amount where the offer has one payment and the offer's settlement amount times 33.0 percent where it has more; where that opening payment is under 300.00 dollars the Hardship Settlement signing window is shortened by 6 days; where it is at least 300.00 dollars but under 600.00 dollars, by 4 days; an opening payment of 600.00 dollars or more takes no opening-payment shortening of the signing window.

The settlement amount and the number of payments are those written on the open Hardship Settlement offer being signed.

## Step one — the opening payment

| Payments on the offer | Opening payment |
|---|---|
| 1 | the whole settlement amount |
| 2 or 3 | the settlement amount times 33.0 percent |

## Step two — the shortening

| Opening payment | Shortening |
|---|---|
| under 300.00 dollars | 6 days |
| 300.00 dollars up to 599.99 dollars | 4 days |
| 600.00 dollars or more | none |

## Hypothetical figures

| Settlement amount | Payments | Opening payment | Shortening |
|---|---|---|---|
| 550.00 dollars | 1 | 550.00 dollars | 4 days |
| 550.00 dollars | 3 | 181.50 dollars | 6 days |
| 2000.00 dollars | 2 | 660.00 dollars | none |
| 1500.00 dollars | 3 | 495.00 dollars | 4 days |
